phase_name: Canonical Human Governance Record Interactive Decision Workflow Independent Verification
summary: Independently re-derived and adversarially verified IWC-001 v1.0 (docs/contracts/INTERACTIVE_WORKFLOW_CONTRACT.md) without trusting Phase 143G's or Phase 143H's own narrative conclusions. Read IWC-001 in full (1700 lines), CHGR-001 in full (1511 lines, every cited CHGR-REQ-### identifier independently re-checked against its own line text), Phase 143G's architecture (850 lines), Phase 143H's phase report (read for scope/process confirmation only, never for its verdict), and TAMC-001/TAMPC-001 directly for the specific provisions IWC-001 Section 19.1 cites (TAMC-REQ-005/024/025/036, TAMPC-REQ-002/010/011). Confirmed a clean repository and no active governed phase before beginning. Independently re-derived the interaction model from first principles (why sessions exist, when decisions/authority/CHGR exist, what runtime may observe) before comparing against IWC-001's actual text, confirming agreement in substance. Independently confirmed 184 unique, sequential, non-reused IWC-REQ identifiers via grep extraction; confirmed no self-referential 'see also' citations (unlike CHGR-001's own disclosed NB-2); confirmed every restated CHGR-REQ-### citation traces accurately to CHGR-001's own frozen text; confirmed the TAMC-001/TAMPC-001 compatibility conclusion is independently re-derivable from their own frozen text. Ran adversarial verification against human authority boundaries, AI boundaries, session architecture, decision-existence semantics, confirmation mechanics, evidence discipline, clarification boundaries, security threats, audit/privacy separation, and all fifteen of IWC-001's own Section 22 adversarial scenarios (independently re-confirmed mitigated), plus three new adversarial scenarios (W16-W18) this phase constructed. W16 discovered a genuine, previously-undisclosed internal contradiction: IWC-001 Section 4.4's ten-state transition table omits Cancelled/Expired/Abandoned exits from five of ten states (Created, EvidenceReady, AwaitingClarification, DecisionSelected, AwaitingConfirmation), directly contradicting IWC-REQ-045/046/047/160's own universal-availability language for cancellation and expiry -- inherited unmodified from Phase 143G's own identical table and not caught by Phase 143H's fifteen-scenario adversarial pass. This finding (B-1) is classified Blocking per this phase's own governing rule (implementation cannot proceed safely without violating either IWC-REQ-042's no-informal-transition-addition rule or IWC-REQ-045/046/047/160's universal-availability guarantees) and is disclosed, not repaired in-pass, consistent with the Phase 143C precedent of deferring substantive requirement-text repairs to a dedicated future phase rather than a same-phase drive-by edit during independent verification. Two further Observations (OBS-1: an unaddressed 'smart resume' re-affirmation gap; OBS-2: Section 9.2's 'objectively testable boundary' heading does not carry forward Phase 143G's own explicit disclosure that the Explanation/Clarification-vs-Persuasion test remains judgment-dependent to apply) were also logged. See docs/PHASE_143I_CANONICAL_HUMAN_GOVERNANCE_RECORD_INTERACTIVE_DECISION_WORKFLOW_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md.

verdict: VERIFIED WITH ONE BLOCKING FINDING -- IWC-001 v1.0 is architecturally faithful to Phase 143G, traceable to CHGR-001's own frozen text at every restated obligation, non-contradictory with TAMC-001/TAMPC-001, and resistant to every adversarial-misuse scenario tested against the AI/human responsibility boundary, decision-existence semantics, and Confirmation mechanics (independently confirmed sound) -- but contains one genuine, previously-undisclosed internal contradiction within its own Section 21 requirement set (B-1: the Section 4.4 state-transition table omits Cancelled/Expired/Abandoned exits from five of ten states, contradicting IWC-REQ-045/046/047/160's universal-availability language), inherited unmodified from Phase 143G and not caught by Phase 143H's own adversarial pass. Not VERIFICATION FAILED because the defect is narrowly confined to state-transition-table completeness, does not weaken any authority, selection, evidence, or Confirmation-binding requirement, and has an obvious, narrow repair.
